speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Oppositional Defiant Disorder (ODD). The clinical picture of a 9-year-old male exhibiting defiance, refusal to comply with authority, and a specific discrepancy between structured settings (gym class refusal) and unstructured peer settings (active recess play) is classic for ODD. His positive social interactions with peers further support this diagnosis over conditions like Conduct Disorder or ADHD, though ruling out ADHD is prudent. Please confirm if these behaviors have been present for at least 6 months and if there is any history of academic decline.
